merch.title: MERCH
merch.intro: Shop original XMASKEDFREAKS apparel, mugs, stickers, collectibles, and future physical releases using platform coins. Each listing clearly shows its official coin price, available options, current inventory, and delivery eligibility before checkout.
merch.shoppingNotes: Choose sizes and product options before adding an item. Inventory is confirmed again at checkout, international availability is shown per product, and eligible orders move into My Orders after payment. Shipping details are collected securely only when a physical purchase is confirmed. New collections can be added without changing the shared cart or checkout flow.
